name: தீபாவளி BAZAAR
tagline: Festival of Lights pop-up market — sarees, sweets & garlands

brief.name: Deepavali Bazaar
brief.industry: Seasonal online marketplace for a Little India Deepavali bazaar — sarees & textiles, sweets (mithai), oil lamps, flower garlands, and gold-look jewellery from local vendors
brief.audience: Tamil & Indian families in Singapore and Malaysia shopping for Deepavali; gift-buyers; foodies seeking authentic mithai. Bilingual Tamil + English.
brief.references: Pothys, Saravana Stores, Little India (Singapore) Deepavali light-up, Mustafa Centre energy
brief.context: Bilingual Tamil + English using Noto Sans/Serif Tamil (full glyph coverage). Category-led market: shop-by-category tiles (Sarees, Sweets, Lamps, Garlands, Jewellery), featured vendors, a Deepavali countdown, and delivery-by-festival messaging. Kolam / rangoli line work as slim dividers and a header band; marigold/magenta/deep-red + gold jewel palette, composed not clashing.
brief.avoid: Deity imagery used as decoration. Kolam as chaotic full-bleed noise. A clashing rainbow with no hierarchy. Tamil rendered in a fallback font that drops glyphs. English-only.
